messages:
sasha: who stole the last cookie from the kitchen jar? crisis in aisle snack.
liam: not me, I witnessed only crumbs and sorrow.
taylor: I confess to looking longingly at the jar. did it look at you back?
emily: lol. footage? kitchen cam? :eyes: (jk, pls don't hack the camera)
sasha: no cameras, just the power of detective work. anyone with alibi?
liam: alibi: in a meeting that ended 3 mins before cookie discovery. can anyone corroborate?
taylor: I have crumbs on my desk but that's from yesterday's muffin. I swear.
kudos-bot: @liam received a reagent of suspicion. :detective: 1 point.
emily: I nominate a poll: 1) Liam 2) Taylor 3) Ghost pastry spirit 4) Unknown hero
sasha: poll opened. react with :one: :two: :three: or :four: to cast.
liam: voting :four: because integrity is chosen.
taylor: voting :three: because it's more dramatic.
emily: :one: because i'm petty.
kudos-bot: Poll results: 1) 1 vote 2) 1 vote 3) 1 vote 4) 1 vote. It's a four-way tie. Ties must be resolved by dance-off.
sasha: dance-off at 4pm in the lounge. BYO dignity.
facilities-bot: Reminder: please label personal snacks and clean crumbs from common areas. Facilities will replace the jar if repeated incidents occur.
liam: is there a prize for the winner besides vindication?
taylor: winner gets first pick of next snack box and a dubious title on Slack.
emily: can the dubious title be 'Official Snack Suspect'?
sasha: agreed. also sending a sternly worded sticky note to the jar: 'This is a shared jar. Hands off!'
kudos-bot: @sasha awarded sticky-note comms badge.
liam: if this continues, I'm instituting a cookie logbook. sign-in required.
taylor: sign-in will just be doodles.
emily: update: found a note under the jar: 'I came, I crumbled, I conquered.' mystery deepens.
sasha: case remains open. next steps: surveillance via witty post-its and a follow-up poll if more crumbs are found.
facilities-bot: Facilities will provide a new airtight jar next week. Please do not leave perishable goods unattended.
liam: closing thread until the cookie jar acts suspiciously again. :cookie:
